title: Atlas Message Envelope
description: Common wrapper for every command, event, progress, and response message on the broker. See docs/architecture/04-messaging-and-data.md#13-message-envelope. A concrete message sets `type` to an event/command name and `payload` to the matching events/<name>.payload.schema.json.

messageId.description: Unique per message; consumers dedupe on this (at-least-once delivery).

correlationId.description: Ties all messages in one flow together.

causationId.description: The messageId that caused this one.

type.description: Dotted event/command name matching a events/<type>.payload.schema.json file, e.g. transcode.completed, asset.approved.

schemaVersion.description: Payload contract version; additive changes only within a major version.

payload.description: Type-specific body; validate against the matching events/<type>.payload.schema.json.
